app.title: VisaCRM
auth.noRegistration: Accounts are created by the platform admin. If you forgot your password, contact them.
auth.changePasswordForced: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to open the workspace.
auth.changePasswordHint: After the change you will need to sign in again on other devices.
nav.label: Main menu
cabinet.comingText: Key figures, clients, cases and the “Needs attention” list will appear here. For now you can change your password and language in the menu.
admin.specialistsSubtitle: Visa specialist accounts on the platform
admin.newSpecialistHint: The system issues a temporary password. The specialist replaces it on first sign-in.
admin.confirmBlock: Block {{email}}? The specialist and their employees will be signed out at once.
admin.confirmReset: Issue a new temporary password to {{email}}? The old one stops working and two-factor sign-in is reset — the specialist sets it up again.
admin.issuedText: Give this password to {{email}} in person or via a messenger.
admin.issuedWarning: The password is shown only once. If it gets lost, issue a new one.
errors.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.account_disabled: This account is blocked. Contact the administrator.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.
errors.email_taken: This email is already in use.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twoFactor.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for VisaCRM.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved during setup. Each code works once.
twoFactor.useRecovery: No access to the app? Use a recovery code
twoFactor.useApp: Use a code from the app
twoFactor.setupIntro: To protect client data, sign-in is confirmed with a code from an app on your phone. Setup takes a minute.
twoFactor.stepInstall: Install an authenticator app: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or another.
twoFactor.stepScan: In the app, add an account and scan the QR code.
twoFactor.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter the key manually:
twoFactor.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.
errors.login_expired: Time to enter the code has run out. Please sign in again.
errors.two_factor_setup_not_started: Reload the page and scan the QR code again.
